Measures
This dataset contains responses from three Inventories related to attachment and social anxiety. The Social Interaction Anxiety Scale is a 20-item inventory that measures the degree to which individuals experience anxiety in social environments (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9). The Experiences in Close Relationships Scale is a shortened, 9-item inventory which measures attachment-related anxiety (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.94). Finally, the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale is a 10-item scale that contains questions on one’s self-esteem (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
Both the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale contain items that were reverse-scored. Specifically, the data for variables SA_5, SA_9, SA_11, SEst_2, SEst_5, SEst_6, SEst_8, and SEst_9 were reverse keyed.
